ashwin: Heads-up: after today's CUDA driver swap on h100-prod (driver 535.82 -> 536.10) we're seeing a kernel-selection hop for the attention path when sequence length moves from ~512 -> 1024. p99 token latency up ~28% on prod-pool-3. Repro script and traces below.

maria: Oof. Do we have profiler dumps? Which kernel was selected before vs after?

ev an: Also saw an automated perf alert earlier. Did the autotuner seed change during the deploy?

ashwin: paste logs:
```
[runtime] selected_kernel: fused_attn_v2 (fast) -> fallback: fused_attn_generic
seqlen=512 chosen=fused_attn_generic latency=7.2ms
seqlen=128 chosen=fused_attn_v2 latency=2.1ms
```
perf summary:
```
pre-upgrade p99=4.5ms (seqlen=512)
post-upgrade p99=5.8ms (seqlen=512)
throughput -8%
```
(added nvprof traces to perf-store: s3://perf-store/1975312345/)

tara: Sounds like the driver changed kernel launch/occupancy tradeoffs and the heuristic tie-breaker flipped. Two immediate mitigations: 1) force a kernel-map override for compute86/h100 for the affected seqlen range, 2) run a small driver rollback on a canary node if mapping override isn't stable.

minh: We can hot-patch runtime with an override like: 
```
kernel_map_override:
  - arch: compute86
    seqlen_max: 768
    prefer: fused_attn_v2
```
It's hot-reloadable via `/admin/runtime-config` and we can canary on pool-3-node7.

sre-bot: [alert] perf-regression: kernel-path-drift detected on prod-pool-3. p99 increased by 28% for model "redwood-base-13b". Incident created: #INC-2025-089

maria: I'll own the canary for the override. Plan: apply to 2 nodes in pool-3 -> run seqlen-heavy smoke runner for 2 hours -> expand if metrics look good. If not, rollback driver or revert autotuner seed.

ev an: If we see similar drift in other pools, we should fallback the autotuner to last-known-good snapshot (tagged `autotune/snapshot-2025-04-12`) until we rebench kernels against the new driver.

ashwin: Agreed. I'll gather more low-level traces (nvprof + kernel timestamps) and upload to perf-store. @maria ping me when you start the canary so I can tail `/var/log/runtime/perf.log`. Also drafting a minimal driver-downgrade playbook for ops.

maria: Starting canary now on pool-3-node7. Will run the smoke harness (seqlen sweep 64..1024) and post results in ~30m. :thumbsup:

ashwin: Thanks — if canary looks bad we do the rollback per playbook, otherwise expand mapping override across pool-3 and then schedule a deeper kernel benchmark across h100 fleet.

maria: will update in-thread with quick metrics snapshot once the smoke run finishes.
